ukraine_escalation_russian_capitulation.public_title: Would escalation force Russia to capitulate in Ukraine?
ukraine_escalation_russian_capitulation.public_summary: Mercouris argued that Moscow shifted from Anchorage diplomacy to waiting for military victory on the Ukrainian battlefields — not capitulation under Kellogg-style pressure.
ukraine_escalation_russian_capitulation.why_it_matters: Tests whether Mercouris read Russian war termination as battlefield victory rather than negotiated yield to Western escalation.

us_israel_iran_war_preparation_2025.public_title: Were Israel and Iran actively preparing for direct war?
us_israel_iran_war_preparation_2025.public_summary: Mercouris tracked an intense US–Iran escalation pattern with Israel in the exchange — trading blows and missile strikes, not mere rhetoric.
us_israel_iran_war_preparation_2025.why_it_matters: Tests whether Mercouris read force-posture and strike cadence as active war preparation before major regional kinetic phases.
